funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage in their career who are the author or editor of the proposed publication. Must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying. Applications from publishers or organisations on behalf of an author are not permitted.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions, contributor fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £40,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards research projects with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non-profit. The exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for the costs of producing exhibition publications that showcase new and insightful research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £3,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis. Items supported must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections relating to British art.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of their career (up to £8,000 tiers); the £8,001-£20,000 tier is available to those at postdoctoral level or with equivalent research experience. Open to international applicants. Applications from organisations not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support allowing individuals to undertake research in British art, including research time (with backfill/staff replacement) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed), or already undertaking, a master's level or doctorate level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree who may face barriers in being able to undertake their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country. Projects must focus on British works of art on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support drawn from the Andrew Wyld Fund enabling students to undertake research trips to examine eighteenth- and nineteenth-century British works on paper (prints, drawings and watercolours) firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if taken part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin the course at any time between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for, or are in receipt of, an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028. Open to international applicants (fixed amount regardless of fee status).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research in British art, covering university fees and living expenses, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives and reframe British art histories.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year, or £70,000 over two years (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA), or have a pending membership application.
opportunities.summary: Research travel bursaries for ERBA members to support a specific research trip (e.g. visiting a library, archive, collection, site, or travelling to meet a key contact), covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.
